blocks.text: Our Quinn tote bag feels everyday-ready in Signature logo-print canvas with generous shoulder straps that can be adjusted for the perfect fit.

items: Equally practical and polished, our Quinn tote is a work-to-weekend staple. This structured silhouette is crafted from textural pebbled leather and trimmed with high-shine hardware that adds to its classic appeal.

items.label: Materials
items.value: Crafted from pebbled leather with gold-tone hardware

items.label: Our Leather
items.value: 100% of the leather in this product comes from tanneries receiving Leather Working Group Gold- or Silver-certification in recognition of their environmental performance

items.label: Polished & Pragmatic
items.value: Whether you're rushing to the office or jetting to your next off-duty adventure, a good tote is essential.

items.label: About the Brand
items.value: Michael Kors is a world-renowned, award-winning designer of luxury accessories and ready-to-wear. Since 1981, his namesake company has defined modern glamour
